tools.name: quipu_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (clients and suppliers) of the Quipu account. Filter by kind, tax id, country, email or free text.

tools.name: quipu_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with its totals of paid and unpaid incomes and expenses.

tools.name: quipu_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices (issued and received). Filter by kind, period, operation date, payment status or contact. Totals and PDF links are in the attributes.

tools.name: quipu_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id. Income invoices include download_pdf_url and ephemeral_open_download_pdf_url (a temporary PDF link).

tools.name: quipu_list_book_entries
tools.description: List all book entries (invoices, tickets and other accounting entries) in one list. Filter by type, kind, period, dates, payment status or contact.

tools.name: quipu_list_numbering_series
tools.description: List invoice numbering series (prefixes). Use a series id when you create a draft invoice.

tools.name: quipu_list_accounting_categories
tools.description: List accounting categories (chart of accounts groups). Filter by kind, prefix or active state.

tools.name: quipu_list_accounting_subcategories
tools.description: List accounting subcategories, optionally for one accounting category.

tools.name: quipu_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact (client or supplier). WRITE: it adds a record to the Quipu account. A tax id is needed before you invoice the contact.

tools.name: quipu_update_contact
tools.description: Update fields of one contact. WRITE: it changes the record; only the fields you send change.

tools.name: quipu_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT income invoice for a contact. WRITE: it adds a draft to Quipu. It sends no issue date or number, so Quipu does not issue or register the invoice; finalize it in the Quipu app.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quipu_list_contacts, quipu_list_book_entries · Private data: quipu_list_contacts, quipu_get_contact, quipu_list_invoices, quipu_list_book_entries, quipu_create_contact, quipu_update_contact, quipu_create_draft_invoice · Public sink: quipu_list_contacts, quipu_update_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quipu_list_contacts, quipu_list_book_entries · Private data: quipu_list_contacts, quipu_get_contact, quipu_list_invoices, quipu_list_book_entries, quipu_create_contact, quipu_update_contact, quipu_create_draft_invoice · Public sink: quipu_list_contacts, quipu_update_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
